_note: MVP product KPIs for Fellow. Edit targets/warn here — the /studio scorecard and the kpi-alerts job both read this file. dir: 'up' = higher is better, 'down' = lower is better. warn = the bad-side pre-threshold (crossing it alerts). target = the goal (reaching it alerts). near = fraction of target that counts as 'approaching' (a good-side pre-threshold that also alerts). source: data = from the meeting dataset; gsc = Search Console; chatbot = chatbot analytics.

kpis.label: Meetings indexed
kpis.why: Total reach — every listing is a door someone can walk through.

kpis.label: States + DC covered
kpis.why: National reach — no one should hit a blank state.

kpis.label: Fellowships with live meetings
kpis.why: Breadth beyond AA/NA — the goal is live data for all 34 fellowships in Fellow's taxonomy.

kpis.label: Thin-coverage states
kpis.why: Depth — states with under 50 in-person meetings feel empty to a local.

kpis.label: Listings refreshed < 12 mo
kpis.why: Trust — stale times and venues send people to a locked door.

kpis.label: Online meetings with a join link
kpis.why: An online meeting without a link isn't actionable.

kpis.label: Search impressions (28d)
kpis.why: Are we surfacing in search at all — the top of the acquisition funnel.

kpis.label: Avg search position
kpis.why: Ranking — page-two results barely get seen.

kpis.label: Chatbot conversations (28d)
kpis.why: Is Ask Fellow being used — the guided path for people who don't know where to start.

kpis.label: Chatbot found-a-meeting rate
kpis.why: When people ask, do they leave with real meetings — the bot's core job.
